keyPoints: Vritt kendra se samaan doori wale binduon ka samooh hai — trijya r, vyaas 2r, paridhi 2πr; parkar se banta hai — ek sir kendra par sthir rehta hai.
Barabar jyaen (chords) kendra se barabar doori par hoti hain — aur iska vilom bhi satya hai: barabar doori par hon to jyaen barabar.
Kendra se jya par daala gaya lamb jya ko samdvibhajit karta hai; teen asanrekhi (non-collinear) binduon se ek hi vritt jaata hai.
Barabar chaapon ke saamne barabar jyaen hoti hain; kendra par chaap ka kon paridhi ke kon ka doguna hota hai.
Ardhvritt ka kon samkon hota hai — vyaas par bana har kon 90 ka hota hai, chahe bindu paridhi par kahin bhi ho.
Chakriya chaturbhuj (cyclic quadrilateral) ke aamne-saamne ke konon ka yog 180 hota hai — ye uski pehchaan hai.
Aam galti: jya aur chaap ko ek samajhna — jya seedha rekha-khand hai, chaap vritt ka vakr hissa hai.
subject: Maths
title: Vritt: Jya aur Kon
